detail.area: NEW YORK, NY – NEW YORK HARBOR – UPPER BAY – ANCHORAGE 21-A
detail.subject: HAZARD
detail.text:
1. NARRATIVE: A SUNKEN BARGE WAS REPORTED IN ANCHORAGE 21-A IN NEW YORK HARBOR.
2. AN OPEN HOPPER BARGE SANK IN ANCHORAGE 21-A IN THE UPPER BAY OF NEW YORK HARBOR IN APPROXIMATE POSITION, 40° 39' 35.64"N, 074° 01' 51.42"W. THE BARGE MEASURES 230’ LONG BY 42’ WIDE BY 14’ TALL AND IT SANK IN APPROXIMATELY 13 FEET OF WATER. PORTIONS OF THE BARGE ARE VISIBLE AT LOW TIDE. THE SUNKEN BARGE IS MARKED AT ITS 4 CORNERS BY THREE RED BUOYS AND ONE YELLOW BUOY. A FLOATING WHITE STROBE LIGHT IS ATTACHED TO EACH MARKING BUOY. MARINERS ARE ADVISED TO USE CAUTION WHILE TRANSITING THE AREA.
